source_text.GH#2596: Design gate round 2 (SECURITY-REVIEWER) on lib/letflow/design/gh2596-exam-managed-types.md (revision 1, folds round-1 F-1..F-3, A-1..A-10).

task.description: Security design gate round 2 for GH #2596. Read-only; no lib/ or test/ edits.

result.summary: ROUND 2: FAIL on ONE small mandatory edit (F-4, a check-then-act race that re-opens the F-3 hole). F-1, F-2, F-3 and A-1..A-10 are otherwise folded and sound. VERIFIED SOUND: (F-1) entry refusal on Repo.in_transaction?() for Stamp and TamperInventory (typed :nested_transaction, nothing set or written) plus the last-statement set_config('letflow.managed_by_stamp','',true) as defence in depth; trigger opens only for exact 'exam' so '' and unset are closed; tests T-09 (i)(ii) pin both; T-07..T-09b run in a non-sandbox :auto-mode case, tenant teardown drops the schema (TenantFixture teardown, so the DELETE trigger on stamped rows does not block cleanup), each test has its own tenant schema. (F-2) T-11 is now an AST scan over lib/ priv/ scripts/ config/ with five assertions (stamp fragment only in stamp.ex + 2 migrations; allowlist of dynamic-SQL files; set_config only in step_writes.ex + stamp.ex with literal first arg; Stamp callers scan; no managed_by update_all outside stamp.ex/insert paths; DISABLE TRIGGER/session_replication_role absent) with a synthetic negative per assertion, and 4.3/R3/11b honestly say tripwire not boundary. (F-3) all-or-nothing per name over every version row, T-16 has older-hostile-v1 and reverse variants. A-1 differences field (names only), A-3 explicit up/down + T-09b round trip, A-4 jsonb equality + update_all set only managed_by + non-SECURITY DEFINER, A-5 tenant-schema schema_migrations, A-7 inventory nested refusal, A-8/A-9 in 11b PR residuals, A-10: all folded. MANDATORY EDIT F-4 (MAJOR, small): 6.1 classifies each name (step 2, field_compatible? over all rows) in READ-ONLY PRE-CHECKS OUTSIDE the transaction, then step 4d stamps 'the NULL rows of stampable names' selected under lock; 4e re-reads only that rows are 'exam', not that they are compatible. A tenant admin can create a new (incompatible or permissive-hostile) version of a runtime name between step 2 and 4c (create_definition takes the same 496_001 name lock, but only after the classification was computed), and 4d then stamps it unchecked and makes it undeletable/unrenamable: the exact F-3 failure via a race. Fix: in the real run perform the classification (step 2: absent / other-module / compatibility of EVERY row) INSIDE the transaction AFTER 4c (name create-locks) and 4d row locks (or re-run it there and roll back/conflict on any divergence from the pre-check); stamp only names that pass that in-lock classification; keep the outside-transaction pass for dry run only. Add a test (T-16 variant): a second connection inserts an incompatible new version of a stampable name after the pre-check but before stamping (or classification-in-lock asserted by injecting the row between the lock and the update via a held name lock) -> that name is a conflict, nothing of it stamped. NON-BLOCKING CLARIFICATIONS (fold at implementer discretion): B-1 state explicitly that every test calling Stamp.run_tenant/TamperInventory.run_tenant (T-14..T-19, T-24..T-27, T-04) must run in the non-sandbox :auto-mode case, because under the Ecto sandbox Repo.in_transaction?() is always true and the new entry guard returns :failed/:nested_transaction (TenantFixture.provisioned_tenant! already sets :auto, so this is a wording gap, not a design flaw). B-2 apply T-11 assertion 3 also to string literals containing set_config inside Ecto fragment(...) (not only Repo.query calls), and assertion 1 to heredocs/sigils. B-3 A-6 only partly folded: add that the inventory query projects only the entity_type and record_id JSON keys and never selects the payload column into Elixir, and that tenant_id/actor_id findings go to operator stdout and are never passed to Logger; T-26 should assert no log line contains field_values/payload. No other invariant issue: INV-1 (explicit prefix, tenant-scoped manifest-registered migration), INV-3 (no sandbox surface), INV-4, INV-5 (constant 403, names/counts/ids only), INV-6 (scoping proof 4.4 + T-11 now meaningful once F-4 closed), INV-7 (bound set_config, only schema name interpolated), INV-8 (typed errors, per-tenant isolation) PASS; INV-2, INV-9, INV-10 N/A. On F-4 being applied the gate is PASS without another full round (re-check of 6.1 step order and the new test only).
advisories_non_blocking: B-1 Non-sandbox mode must be stated for every test that calls Stamp/TamperInventory (see summary).
B-2 T-11 set_config assertion should also cover fragment() string literals and heredocs/sigils.
B-3 A-6 residual: payload-column projection rule, no Logger of findings, T-26 log assertion.

invariants_assessed.INV-1: APPLIES. PASS: explicit prefix on every query, tenant-scoped manifest-registered migration, tenant_id derived from the registration.
invariants_assessed.INV-2: NOT-APPLICABLE: no new API response type.
invariants_assessed.INV-3: APPLIES (checked). PASS: no host function reaches set_config or entity_definitions UPDATE.
invariants_assessed.INV-4: APPLIES. PASS: reports keep tags and exception modules, never messages.
invariants_assessed.INV-5: APPLIES. PASS: constant 403 body, reports hold names/counts/ids (B-3 hardening).
invariants_assessed.INV-6: APPLIES. Scoping proof (4.4 + T-11 AST scan) is sufficient only once F-4 is closed, because the stamp can otherwise be applied to a row never compatibility-checked. FAIL until F-4.
invariants_assessed.INV-8: APPLIES. PASS: typed errors incl. :nested_transaction, per-tenant isolation, non-zero exit on :failed.
invariants_assessed.INV-10: NOT-APPLICABLE: no route or permission added.

required_changes: F-4: in Stamp 6.1 move the per-name classification (absent / stamped-by-other / field-compat of EVERY row) into the real-run transaction after the name create-locks and row locks (pre-check stays for dry run only), stamp only names passing the in-lock classification, and add a T-16 race variant (incompatible new version inserted after the pre-check, before the stamp -> name is a conflict, nothing stamped).
